```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        profile: minimal
        override: true

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        cargo install cargo-edit
        cargo install cargo-clippy
        cargo install cargo-tarpaulin

    - name: Build project
      run: cargo build --release

    - name: Run tests
      run: cargo test --all

    - name: Check Clippy warnings
      run: cargo clippy --all -- -D warnings

    - name: Update README
      run: |
        echo "## Installation" >> README.md
        echo "" >> README.md
        echo "To install AICheck from crates.io, run:" >> README.md
        echo "" >> README.md
        echo "```sh" >> README.md
        echo "cargo install aicheck" >> README.md
        echo "```" >> README.md

    - name: Add license file
      run: cp LICENSE .

    - name: Add missing Cargo.toml fields
      run: |
        sed -i 's/^$/license = "MIT"/' Cargo.toml
        sed -i 's/^$/repository = "https:\/\/github.com\/MatrixA\/aicheck"/' Cargo.toml
        sed -i 's/^$/homepage = "https:\/\/github.com\/MatrixA\/aicheck"/' Cargo.toml
        sed -i 's/^$/keywords = ["rust", "ai", "check"]/' Cargo.toml
        sed -i 's/^$/categories = ["command-line-utilities"]/' Cargo.toml

    - name: Commit changes
      run: |
        git add .
        git commit -m "Pre-publish audit: fix issues for crates.io release"
        git push origin main
```
